fact: The Reserve Bank of Malawi issued a directive setting complaint-handling procedures for banks and other financial service providers, with resolution within 2 to 30 days, no fees to customers and penalties up to K50 million per institution and K10 million per board or management member.
RBM's 2024 annual report says 1,301 complaints were escalated to the Registrar of financial institutions, of which 655 were resolved.
RBM's 2024 report counts 46,969 banking-sector complaints linked to failed digital financial services, where accounts were debited without the service delivered.
Malawi recorded 36,481 complaints of digital payment challenges out of 396.6 million digital transactions from April 2023 to March 2024, as stated by RBM's Deputy Governor.
The RBM says its fintech regulatory framework under development is meant to ensure consumer protection, data privacy and risk mitigation.
